name: publicWeb_getEventRunners
description: Resolves PackTrack runner ids (HC.Hasher.id) to public display names and profile photos for the public-website run map. Unauthenticated (anonymous PublicWebApi GET). The ids are already exposed by the public GetPositions endpoint; this only maps them to DisplayName and Photo — no email or other PII. Photo exposure was explicitly approved by James (2026-07-10); IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory must NOT be used to gate it (unimplemented feature, not a consent flag).

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run's public-facing UUID; used as an existence guard so an empty name list is not treated as a 404. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: userIds
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited ('|') list of HC.Hasher.id runner ids from the PackTrack position payload.

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Only when the guard at line 34 fails (@publicEventId NULL or the empty GUID); outside the TRY, NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog; the SP returns.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed text naming the missing parameter.

rowsets.name: EventExistence
rowsets.description: Single { EventFound = 1 } row when any HC.Event has this PublicEventId (deleted / removed / IsVisible are NOT checked); 0 rows when not found (shim returns 404).

rowsets.name: Runners
rowsets.description: One row per id in @userIds that is a live hasher (deleted = 0, Removed 0 or NULL); may be empty. Returned even when rowset 0 was empty.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: Hasher.Photo as-is. May be a blob URL or an app-only 'bundle://avatar-NN' value — web clients must skip non-http(s) values.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @userIds. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Existence check ignores deleted / removed runs
codeSmells.detail: Line 45-47 matches any HC.Event with the PublicEventId, so a deleted or hidden run still answers EventFound = 1 rather than 404.

codeSmells.issue: Validation refusal not logged; wrong SP name in log
codeSmells.detail: The { Success = 0 } guard (lines 34-38) writes no HC.ErrorLog row. The CATCH logs ErrorName 'Unhandled error in getEventRunners' and HcVersion '<unknown>' rather than the publicWeb_ name and '<web>'.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never expose additional hasher PII (email etc.) without an explicit decision from James (photo was approved 2026-07-10)
Never use IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory in decision logic — it belongs to the unimplemented Global Hash Directory feature
